name: semantic-crosscheck
description: Cross-layer verification for an ontology plus semantic layer on PostgreSQL 17, for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Prove that a PostgreSQL closure, SHACL rules, OWL reasoning and a Cube model agree.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.20.0 adds an optional offline semantic-preflight command. Explicit business-definition contracts bind stable metric IDs, labels/aliases and meaning context to existing measure, Gold and generated Cube declarations. Structured plans with missing, ambiguous or candidate selections require clarification; complete conflicts fail. Captured inputs are bounded and path/change guarded; evidence contains hashes, positional IDs and fixed reasons. No SQL is generated or executed, and no database, model or network is consulted. Reviewed is an unauthenticated caller assertion; matching population, unit, denominator and time declarations do not prove SQL semantics. Plan periods do not bind SQL parameters. Defaults, dependency pins and operational report authority remain unchanged; contract/plan integration with the operational report is deferred. Rerun operational stages after upgrading because engine code changed. No active installation or company database is modified.
defaultPrompt: Use semantic-crosscheck to run the synthetic demo end to end.
Use semantic-crosscheck to verify my crosscheck.toml against PostgreSQL and explain what is not proven.
